name: P ZERO Road TLR

origin.basis: Italian tire maker; Pirelli says the P ZERO Race range is made at its plant in Italy near its Milan headquarters.

manufacturing.basis: The P ZERO Road TLR page does not state where it is made.

positioning: All-round and endurance tubeless tire with a liner-backed 120 TPI casing and the EVO compound.
weight_basis: Pirelli claims per size; no weight is listed for 26 mm.
pressure_note: The product page gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

wet_notes.summary: Pirelli says the EVO compound gives optimal wet grip alongside rolling resistance and durability.

availability.note: Listed in Pirelli's UK catalogue with a dealer finder; mainland China and North American availability not verified for this line.

caveats: Hookless compatibility and maximum pressure are not stated.

image.shown: P ZERO Road TLR sidewall as pictured in Pirelli's catalogue; one photo covers every width.
image.alt: Close-up of a Pirelli P ZERO Road TLR road tire sidewall

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.

reports.summary: Light and fast without giving up grip.

checks.note: Three of 4 written reviews describe only fitting or a purchase; a separate tube-type P ZERO clincher listing is not counted
Only the tube-type P ZERO Road was tested
